scope: Read-only matching of current passed reports to recorded real fresh-agent dispatch and result consumption. Earliest reader journals name only consumed report paths and cannot establish a historical report hash; later reader journals identify section hashes or complete report hashes. Every technical result must identify its complete report hash. Current raw sections are checked separately here and by content/introduction gates. This check cannot independently prove reading, source verification, or report authorship; those require the actual agent transcript. It never writes reviews or verdicts.
